# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old at the beginning of the series, dying several years later.  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c16 P14](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0014), [v1 c36 P39](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0039)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew is an odd-looking, ungainly man with stooping shoulders and long iron-gray hair touching his shoulders. He wears a full, soft brown beard that he has had since he was twenty years old. By his later years, he appears noticeably grayer and visibly ages due to overwork and failing health.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c36 P26](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0026)_

## Personality

Matthew is exceptionally shy, quiet, and meek, dreading interactions with women and strangers and hating to go anywhere he might be forced to talk. Despite his reserve, he is deeply sympathetic, kind-hearted, and quietly persistent when he sets his mind on something. He enjoys listening to talkative people provided they do not expect him to speak, and he forms a warm, tender bond with Anne Shirley, whom he loves to spoil.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)_

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables with his sister Marilla and decided to adopt an orphan boy to help him with farm duties as his health declined. When he drove to Bright River station to collect the child, he unexpectedly found Anne Shirley instead and brought her home. Touched by her personality, Matthew quietly insisted on keeping her at Green Gables despite Marilla's initial reluctance. Over the years, he supported Anne, buying her a puffed-sleeve dress for Christmas and continuously expressing pride in her academic successes. As his heart condition worsened with age and overwork, he suffered a fatal shock upon reading of the failure of the Abbey Bank where the family savings were stored. Following his sudden death, he was buried in Avonlea, where Anne regularly visits his grave.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c3 P5](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0005), [v1 c3 P60](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0060), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P35](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0035), [v1 c36 P28](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0028), [v1 c36 P34](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0034), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000)_

- Son of the man who founded the secluded Green Gables homestead  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Has looked substantially the same since he was twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
